user.title: Multimedia setup
user.description: Foundation discovers and selects integrations/devices per multimedia concept first. If no selections exist, create the integration and then configure Screen, Amplifier and Media Sources in RHI Foundation. Next open Multimedia Configure to link rooms, input routes and activities.

data.name: Name
data.confirm: Create Multimedia and configure Foundation first

room.title: Add a Multimedia room
room.description: Choose a Home Assistant area when available. A central device can be used by several rooms.

display.title: Screen / TV
display.description: Select one of the displays already selected in Foundation. Music-only rooms may have no screen.

amplifier.title: Audio / amplifier
amplifier.description: Optional receiver or speaker zone from Foundation. Leave empty if the TV handles audio itself.

sources.title: Media sources
sources.description: Choose the Foundation-selected Apple TV, Shield, console or player used in this room. The same central source can be linked across rooms.

activity.title: Create an activity
activity.description: Choose a standard activity pattern. Multimedia links the logical roles; no physical HDMI connection is inferred.

route.title: Physical input routes
route.description: Confirm the exact input or sound mode exposed by Home Assistant for this device. No guessed HDMI routing.

next.title: Continue
next.description: Add more rooms or activities, or review everything before saving.

review.title: Review and save
review.description:
Review the actual selected devices and input routes below. Deferred means the device must be awake before verification. Unchanged unavailable links are retained. No physical commands are sent.

data.confirm_remove: I confirm deleting the listed rooms

validate_room_update.title: Device changes affect existing activities
validate_room_update.description: These activities reference changed or removed devices: {affected}. Confirm removing those activities, then recreate them with the new routing. Nothing is changed until final Save.

frontend.title: Multimedia dashboard card
frontend.description: Enable the bundled card without changing room mappings or the activity engine.

room_settings.title: Room name and location
room_settings.description: Change the display name or area without replacing room identity.

harmony_owner.title: Room control ownership
harmony_owner.description: Choose one owner. Before transferring to Harmony, include every native endpoint the hub may control, including shared devices and coupled zones. Stop all affected Premium activities and set the Harmony hub to PowerOff. Disable competing automations and dashboard writers. Shared declared endpoints cannot be controlled by other Premium rooms while Harmony owns this scope. Existing Premium activity definitions are retained.

data.confirm: I confirm the complete affected scope and single-writer cutover

tv_wake.title: Device Wake-on-LAN (MAC / IP)
tv_wake.description: Optionally configure WOL per Foundation-approved native media device. Use a MAC registered on that exact HA device; the destination IPv4 and UDP port are optional. Save never sends a packet.

quick_edit_activity.title: Quick edit activity
quick_edit_activity.description: Edit the name, the participating Foundation-selected native media player and exact TV/receiver input routes. HDMI-only sources need no native player. Removing player-specific commands requires explicit confirmation; stop active activities before saving.

data.confirm_source_steps: Confirm removal of commands belonging to the disconnected player

dell_display.title: Dell C8621QT LAN display
dell_display.description: Configure the actual display on a private LAN address. On initial setup, this creates one native Home Assistant display, which must then be approved in Foundation before use in a room. No Wake-on-LAN or hard power off.

dell_remove.title: Remove Dell display
dell_remove.description: Confirm removal. Only displays that are not linked into a Multimedia room may be removed.

guided_activity.title: What would you like to do?
guided_activity.description: Choose a supported activity intent first. Then select a real configured room and its native media routes. No device is controlled during setup.

data.activity_type: What would you like to do?

guided_room.title: In which room?
guided_room.description: Choose a supported activity intent first. Then select a real configured room and its native media routes. No device is controlled during setup.

cec_device.title: Native HDMI-CEC per device
cec_device.description: Only enable when HDMI-CEC is really enabled on this selected Home Assistant device; enabling alone never skips commands.

cec_activity.title: Verified HDMI-CEC relationship
cec_activity.description: Confirm the actual physical HDMI connection between both CEC-enabled native devices. Choose which commands the upstream device performs automatically. The explicit destination input remains a mandatory target-state check. If missing, the resident may use Fix It; no physical command is sent while configuring.

data.verified_link: I have verified the physical HDMI link and CEC on both devices
data.skip_power_on: CEC will switch the target on (skip native power-on)
data.skip_power_off: CEC will switch the target off (skip native power-off)
data.skip_source: CEC will select the configured target input (skip native source command)

assisted.title: Assisted setup
assisted.description: Choose what you want to configure. Existing device bindings and activities are preserved.

speech_endpoint.title: Speaker speech notifications
speech_endpoint.description: Choose an approved Cast player and native TTS provider. This creates one native notification destination for all bindings of that asset. Speech is sent only when the player is already idle; it never wakes or interrupts playback. Core Notifications owns destination consent and rules.

data.confirm: Confirm the selected asset and all its room bindings
